errors.text_span: Първият сектор е оранжев, етикетиран с „Не“ и представлява 33.3% от общият обем.
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that the orange sector (33.3%) is the first sector, when in fact it is the second sector.

errors.text_span: вторият сектор е син, етикетиран с „Да“ и представлява 66.7% от общият обем.
errors.evidence: The description mistakenly implies that the blue sector (66.7%) is the second sector without clearly distinguishing the order properly.
The description fails to mention that the sectors are visually arranged in a pie chart format and does not emphasize the difference in size explicitly.
The purpose of the pie chart is not clearly stated, particularly in relation to the implications of the answers.
